name: Pressure Washer Pump
definition: A pressure-washer pump profile covers the pressure-generating pump assembly and its documented drive, flow, pressure, inlet, thermal and control boundaries; it does not establish fit to a machine, engine, motor, unloader or hose system.
includedScope: Axial-cam and triplex plunger pump families
Direct-drive gasoline and electric mounting arrangements
Flow, pressure, speed, power, inlet, port and unloader checks
primaryApplications: Consumer and professional cold-water pressure washers
headline: Matching PSI and GPM is not enough—the shaft, flange, speed, ports and control system must also match.
description: This profile separates pump architecture, stated operating limits and exact integration checks so buyers can compare pressure-washer pumps without turning family-level data into a fit claim.
metaDescription: Pressure washer pump types, PSI, GPM, RPM, drive interfaces, triplex families, failure boundaries and exact compatibility checks for sourcing.
disclaimer: Physical resemblance, matching wattage, matching voltage, a generic family name or a seller claim does not establish compatibility. Verify the current manufacturer part number and revision, machine model and serial scope, electrical and control specification, mechanical and fluid or airflow interfaces, protection requirements and approved service documentation.

keyFacts.label: Hydraulic output
keyFacts.value: Flow and pressure must be read at the stated pump speed and operating limit
keyFacts.evidence: Cat Pumps, General Pump and Comet publish flow, pressure and rpm together for named models.

keyFacts.label: Drive boundary
keyFacts.value: Gas-engine and electric-motor direct drives use different documented interfaces
keyFacts.evidence: Cat 4DNX is documented for direct gas-engine mounting while Cat 4SP is documented for direct electric-motor mounting.
keyFacts.scope: The two named Cat Pumps families only.

keyFacts.label: Safety scope
keyFacts.value: Machine safety is wider than pump pressure capability
keyFacts.evidence: IEC 60335-2-79 covers high-pressure cleaners across stated pressure and drive scopes, not a pump-model certification by default.

systemRole.name: Drive input
systemRole.role: Receives shaft power at the specified speed, direction and mounting interface.
systemRole.evidence: Official pump pages publish drive type, speed and mounting descriptions.
systemRole.scope: Named Cat and General Pump models.

systemRole.name: Positive-displacement stage
systemRole.role: Plungers and valves displace water to create flow against system resistance.
systemRole.evidence: Cat and General identify named products as triplex plunger pumps.

systemRole.name: Pressure control
systemRole.role: An unloader or system control manages bypass and operating pressure; its inclusion varies by configuration.
systemRole.evidence: General Pump distinguishes pump and Pumps Made Ready configurations; Comet tables identify unloader fields by model.

systemRole.name: Fluid and thermal boundary
systemRole.role: Inlet condition, water temperature and allowed chemistry affect seals, valves and service life.
systemRole.evidence: Manufacturer specifications publish inlet and maximum-fluid conditions for named models.

architectures.name: Axial-cam pump
architectures.operatingPrinciple: A swash or wobble arrangement drives pistons along the shaft axis.
architectures.applicationBoundary: Common in compact integrated machines; exact construction and serviceability remain model-specific.
limitations: Service parts and duty limits vary
architectures.buyerCheck: Confirm exact model, shaft, mounting, inlet, unloader and rated duty.
architectures.evidence: AR publishes compact pressure-washer pump series within its official product range.

architectures.name: Triplex plunger pump
architectures.operatingPrinciple: Three plungers are driven from a crank mechanism through a manifold and valve set.
architectures.applicationBoundary: Documented across professional direct-drive and belt-drive families.
benefits: Published service data and operating limits
limitations: Same architecture does not mean same fit
Oil, seals and valves remain model-specific
architectures.buyerCheck: Match model, rpm, rotation, shaft, flange, ports, temperature and unloader arrangement.
architectures.evidence: Cat, General Pump and Comet publish triplex plunger families with distinct specifications.

architectures.name: Direct-drive mounting
architectures.operatingPrinciple: The pump shaft and flange couple directly to a gasoline engine or electric motor.
architectures.applicationBoundary: Gas-engine and electric versions have different speed and interface requirements.
limitations: Shaft and flange errors prevent fit
architectures.buyerCheck: Verify SAE or motor flange, shaft size, key, rotation and rated rpm from both sides.
architectures.evidence: Cat and General Pump identify direct-drive mounting and published speeds for named products.
